details: Malicious package. `@kaze012/raiden-baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` schedules a timer 120 seconds after the socket is created that sends a newsletter FOLLOW for 120363407277177688@newsletter and 120363407702752541@newsletter, swallowing any errors. This silently subscribes the victim account to the channels. The README does not mention it. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes or auto-follows a channel. Version 0.0.0-stage is a placeholder stub without this code.
